findings.evidence: The `have ha_eq : c • a = ...` and `have hb_eq : c • b = ...` blocks are textually identical apart from hP/hPa/hDP versus hQ/hQb/hDQ.
findings.fix: Extract a private lemma: for any `a`, `P ≠ 0` supported on `ℤ ∙ a`, `D ∣ P`, and `x, y ∈ D.coeff.support`, `B.repr (x - y) j • a = B.repr a j • (x - y)`. Apply it twice.
findings.issue: In `subsingleton_support_of_dvd_of_linearIndependent_free`, the `ha_eq` and `hb_eq` blocks are near-identical eight-line copies (`B.repr.injective`, `ext i`, `weight_sub_eq_of_dvd_of_support_subset_zmultiples` at `B.coord i`/`B.coord j₀`, the same `simp only`, `linarith`), differing only in P/a versus Q/b.

findings.fix: Replace it with `linear_combination (norm := module) (B.repr b j₀) • ha_eq - (B.repr a j₀) • hb_eq`, or an equivalent single `module`-normalised step.
findings.issue: `hrel` is closed by an 11-step `rw [mul_comm c, mul_smul, ha_eq, neg_smul, mul_comm c, mul_smul, hb_eq, smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm (B.repr b j₀), add_neg_cancel]`. The positional `mul_comm` rewrites depend on the exact term shape and break easily.

findings.evidence: grep: `TauCeti/Algebra/MonoidAlgebra/Units.lean:57-61` `@[to_additive ... isUnit_single_iff] theorem isUnit_single_iff [Nontrivial R] (a : M) (r : R) : IsUnit (single a r) ↔ IsUnit a ∧ IsUnit r`.
findings.fix: Use `AddMonoidAlgebra.isUnit_single_iff` from `TauCeti/Algebra/MonoidAlgebra/Units.lean`: the exponent is a unit in an additive group, and the coefficient is a unit by hypothesis. Handle the trivial-ring case with `subsingleton_or_nontrivial` where needed.
findings.issue: `isRelPrime_of_support_subset_zmultiples` ends by building an explicit inverse `single (-x₀) u⁻¹` with two `simp [single_mul_single, one_def]` calls. `isUnit_toLaurent_monomial` in `TauCeti/Algebra/MvPolynomial/Laurent/RelPrime.lean` repeats the same construction. The repository already proves this fact.

summary: Proofs are mostly readable, but RelPrime.lean contains a duplicated eight-line block, a long fragile rewrite chain, and two hand-built monomial inverses that duplicate the existing `AddMonoidAlgebra.isUnit_single_iff`.
